# SIIMA Critics Award for Best Actor – Tamil

SIIMA Critics Award for Best Actor – Tamil is presented by Vibri media group as part of its annual South Indian International Movie Awards, for best acting done by an actor in Tamil films, who are selected by the jury. The award was first given in 2013 for films released in 2012.
Superlatives
* R. Madhavan has maximum awards with three wins.
* Dhanush and Sivakarthikeyan have also won the SIIMA Award for Best Actor – Tamil.
